name: Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform Integration
description: Integration pack for Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform, providing connectivity to Azure Entra ID Managed Identities, Azure Resource Manager (ARM / Bicep), AKS clusters, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor / Log Analytics.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure Management / Monitoring, Observability & SRE
capabilities.description: Integrates Azure Virtual Machines, AKS Kubernetes, Resource Groups, and ARM/Bicep templates. Integrates Azure Monitor metrics, Log Analytics workspaces, and Application Insights.

capabilities.name: Platform & Developer Experience
capabilities.description: Integrates Azure Entra ID Workload Identity and Azure CLI authentication.

checklists.name: Azure Cloud Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Azure Workload Identity authentication, AKS credentials, and Azure Monitor alerts.

items.statement: Azure Entra ID Service Principal / Workload Identity authenticates with Azure RBAC permissions.
Azure Key Vault secrets fetch securely using Managed Identity tokens without hardcoded credentials.
Azure Monitor Alert rules trigger Action Group webhooks on resource metric thresholds.

reviewGates.name: Azure Cloud Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Azure Cloud Architect confirms that Entra ID authentication and Azure Monitor alerts satisfy cloud standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Azure integration verify Workload Identity authentication and Key Vault secret retrieval?
